governing_law.evidence_quote: ISDA Agreements Subject to New York Law Only

threshold.value: Infinity for Party A (subject to being zero under specified trigger or collateralization conditions); infinity for Party B.
threshold.evidence_quote: “Threshold” means with respect to Party A: infinity; provided that the Threshold with respect to Party A shall be zero for so long as no Relevant Entity has the First Trigger Required Ratings or a Collateralization Event is occurring

minimum_transfer_amount.value: USD $100,000 for Party A (or USD $50,000 if S&P rates the Notes and aggregate Note Balance falls below $50,000,000); USD $100,000 for Party B (or USD $50,000 under the same note balance condition).

rounding.value: Delivery Amount rounded up to nearest integral multiple of USD $10,000; Return Amount rounded down to nearest integral multiple of USD $10,000.
rounding.evidence_quote:
The
      Delivery Amount will be rounded up to the nearest integral multiple of USD
      $10,000.  The Return Amount will be rounded down to the nearest
      integral multiple of USD $10,000.
